title: One-round composite machine
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k+2$ work tapes and states consisting of a control key together with a state of that key’s assigned phase machine. Its initial state is the entry key with its unique state, and its transitions combine the phase machines with the control-phase reduction rule.
